2026-09-02: 14 commits, no trades opened or closed (last close 09-01 XAUUSD MOMENTUM -1R; 7 closed/30d, 42.9% WR, expectancy -$23.50). The theme was enforcement: rules that existed only as words in CLAUDE.md now have scripts behind them. tasks/claims_check.cjs verifies the boot file against the code and found 4 stale claims, including GET /api/performance — a route that does not exist while the same file elsewhere said so, and the wrong half was the half sending you to call it. Line anchors moved twice in one day (8df52e6 shifted them ~97 lines), which is the point: they rot on every insertion above them. The duplicate guard and evidence gate shipped as hooks and the duplicate guard was verified firing on this laptop. The gate was confirmed at 70 on both boxes and the CLAUDE.md bullet announcing 65 turned out to be the stale claim it was written to prevent. Three silent failures closed: a graph check with no floor reporting "Graph OK" over an empty store, a strategy searcher discarding the stderr that named its own failures, and a VPS backup archiving a 15,016-file virtualenv nightly. Recovered the SELL_BOUNCE per-asset walk-forward answer that existed only on the VPS — no, Gold gets worse and trades less because a match displaces a long. One thing found and left open: post-edit-check.ps1 exits 1 at a gate-health baseline stale since 2026-08-31, so the evidence gate shipped this morning has never printed once.
